Earlier check-in is possible without surcharge in case that room is available. Otherwise, you can leave your luggage in our luggage room (that is used 24 hours with free of charge) and take a rest at our lobby or in our restaurant. We are pleased to recommend you to visit arounded attractive sights. Cancellation Policy: - Any cancellation​ or amendment is​ received before 3 days (​before ​72 hours) prior to​ your​ arrival date, no fee will be charged. - Any cancellation​ or amendment is​ received in 3 days (​in 72 hours) to arrival date, 100% of the first night room fee and prepaid payment will be charged. - Failure to arrival at​ our​ hotel​ will be treated as No-show, 100% of ​the first night room fee and prepaid payment will be charged and hotel rooms are not guaranteed. Payment Method: - By cash. - By Visa Card, Master Card or American Express, etc plus 4% bank fee is applied. Children and Extra bed: All children under 6 years stay free of charge when sharing beds. Older child or adult will be charged US$ 12 per person per night. Pets: Not allowed.
